name: Do I need a site feasibility consultation if I already own land?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a site feasibility consultation if I already own land?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, even if you already own land, a site feasibility consultation is highly recommended. Land ownership does not automatically guarantee that a tiny home can be legally built or easily connected to utilities. Zoning regulations, local building codes, environmental factors, or specific site conditions could still present significant challenges. A consultation ensures your existing property is suitable and helps anticipate any necessary preparations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, even with owned land, a consultation is recommended to check zoning, building codes, utilities, and site conditions for tiny home viability.
